metadata.Name: PxSLU
metadata.Description: A dataset of spoken drug prescriptions in French, collected through a dialogue system on smartphones, with 4 hours of recordings from 55 participants.
metadata.Paper Title: A Spoken Drug Prescription Dataset in French for Spoken Language Understanding

metadata.Abstract: Spoken medical dialogue systems are increasingly attracting interest to enhance access to healthcare services and improve quality and traceability of patient care. This paper presents PxSLU, the first spoken medical drug prescriptions corpus, comprising around 4 hours of speech recordings acquired from human-machine interactions using a prototype of a goal-oriented dialogue system used for prescribing medicine.
